sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Test setup
sections.what: Imports the file system and path tools, the test tools, and the two lenient parsing functions.
sections.why: Gives the tests the tools to walk folders and read files.

sections.name: walk
sections.title: Folder walker and decimal-overs pattern
sections.what: Lists every TypeScript and TSX file under a folder. Defines a text pattern that spots decimal overs arithmetic in common forms.
sections.why: Makes the scan possible and defines what counts as misuse.
sections.watch_out: The pattern is a heuristic, so it can both miss misuse and flag harmless lines.

sections.name: legalBalls used everywhere
sections.title: Single source of over math
sections.what: Checks that lenient parsing returns balls for valid overs and nothing for invalid ones, that completed overs round down, and that the scan finds no decimal overs arithmetic outside the legal-balls module.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps one place responsible for over arithmetic.
sections.watch_out: The exemption looks at the end of the file path. A file with the same name in another folder would also be skipped.

summary: Checks that no code outside the legal-balls module does its own decimal overs arithmetic, and that lenient parsing and completed-overs counting work.
purpose: Enforces one trusted source for over arithmetic across the whole app.
why: Likely reason: scattered over math would reintroduce the decimal bugs that the legal-balls module prevents.
how: Walks every code file under the src folder, skips the legal-balls module, and checks each line against a pattern for decimal overs arithmetic. Also checks lenient parsing and completed overs.
inputs: Code files under src, plus literal test values.
outputs: Pass or fail. A failure lists the offending file and line.
risks: The pattern is a heuristic. It can miss new ways of doing the math, or flag harmless lines.
debug: Read the offender lines in the failure message. Move the math into the legal-balls module, or change the pattern on purpose and explain why.
